summary: Commit 1b8de07 extracts the repaint/live logtail-source decision into `selectLogtail(p renderParams, read logtailReader) (string, []byte, error)`, closing round 1's major finding. Everything requiring g/v (readLogfileRecent's v.Size() geometry, v.Clear(), Reopen's DB round-trip, the printCmdline error write, logtail.Size bookkeeping) stays inside the thunk passed from renderFrame's case block; selectLogtail itself only chooses, and does not evaluate the thunk eagerly. Control-flow comparison against 0ae64cf confirms the consolidation to one printLogtail call is behaviour-preserving: byte output, the Clear-only-on-content semantics, and the error-return/printCmdline behaviour are all identical. I independently reran the round-1 mutation (`if !p.fromFile {` -> `if false {`, now inside selectLogtail) and confirmed it reddens both Test_selectLogtail_repaintNeverInvokesTheRead and Test_repaintLogtail_noFileAccess; reverted cleanly. renderParams and renderFrame's signature are untouched, task 03's seam is unchanged, and the change stays within top/stat.go and top/stat_test.go (top/pause.go and top/pause_test.go have zero diff in this commit). The major is resolved.

round1MajorResolution.finding: Test_repaintLogtail_noFileAccess called renderLogtail directly, a function with no path to config.logtail, so the adversary fixture was inert and a mutation removing the repaint/live routing distinction went undetected.
round1MajorResolution.fix: selectLogtail(p renderParams, read logtailReader) (string, []byte, error) extracted as the single place the source is chosen: `if !p.fromFile { return p.logPath, p.logBuf, nil }; return read()`. The live branch's file read, v.Clear(), Reopen, printCmdline and Size bookkeeping all moved into the `read` closure passed in from renderFrame's case stat.CollectLogtail, unchanged in content.
round1MajorResolution.verificationMethod: Read the diff, confirmed the thunk is passed as a value and only invoked inside read() when p.fromFile is true; independently reran the exact mutation described (if !p.fromFile { -> if false {) inside selectLogtail and confirmed via `go test ./top/ -run 'Logtail|logtail|selectLogtail' -v` that it fails Test_selectLogtail_repaintNeverInvokesTheRead (t.Fatal fires) and Test_repaintLogtail_noFileAccess (adversary bytes/path leak through, Size advances to 33); reverted, git diff --stat top/stat.go is empty afterward.

verifiedInvariants.gocui_bound_work_stays_in_thunk: confirmed by reading: readLogfileRecent(v, ...), the size<Size rotation check with v.Clear()+Reopen(app.db,...), both printCmdline(g, ...) error writes, and app.config.logtail.Size = size all remain inside the closure literal passed to selectLogtail; selectLogtail's own body touches neither g nor v nor app.config
verifiedInvariants.thunk_not_eager: confirmed: `path, buf, err := selectLogtail(p, func() (...) {...})` passes an unevaluated function value; selectLogtail's `if !p.fromFile { return ...}` branch returns without ever calling `read()`, so on the repaint path the closure body never executes
verifiedInvariants.single_printLogtail_call: confirmed: both paths now fall through to one `err = printLogtail(v, path, buf)` after selectLogtail returns, replacing the two call sites (one per branch) that existed in 0ae64cf; behaviour is identical because both call sites previously invoked printLogtail with the same respective arguments
verifiedInvariants.byte_output_and_clear_semantics_unchange: printLogtail/renderLogtail definitions are untouched by this commit (grep confirms their line numbers are the only place they're defined); Test_renderLogtail_outputUnchanged and Test_renderLogtail_emptyBufferPrintsNothing, unmodified, still pass
verifiedInvariants.error_path_not_swallowed_or_reordered: confirmed: the thunk returns ("", nil, err) immediately after each printCmdline call, exactly mirroring 0ae64cf's `printCmdline(...); return err`; selectLogtail propagates that error unchanged via `return read()`; renderFrame's `if err != nil { return err }` immediately after the selectLogtail call is new only in position, not in effect — Test_selectLogtail_livePathPropagatesReadError pins this and passes
verifiedInvariants.renderParams_renderFrame_signature_untou: confirmed: `func renderFrame(g *gocui.Gui, app *app, s stat.Stat, props stat.PostgresProperties, p renderParams) error` is byte-identical between 0ae64cf and 1b8de07; top/pause.go (which owns renderParams) has zero diff in this commit
verifiedInvariants.file_perimeter: confirmed: `git diff --stat 0ae64cf 1b8de07` touches only top/stat.go and top/stat_test.go, both within task 09's allowed file set
verifiedInvariants.single_routing_check: confirmed: `if !p.fromFile` appears exactly once as executable code (top/stat.go:354, inside selectLogtail); its only other two occurrences in the package are inside doc comments (top/stat.go:344, top/stat_test.go:1801)
verifiedInvariants.no_live_path_access_reachable_from_repai: confirmed both by reading (selectLogtail's early return precedes any g/v/config.logtail touch) and by the reverted mutation test above

verificationRun.targeted_tests: go test ./top/ -run 'Logtail|logtail|selectLogtail|frameStore|publishFrame|repaint' -race -count=3 -v : all pass, no races
verificationRun.vet_gofmt: go vet ./top/... clean; gofmt -l top/ empty
verificationRun.mutation_reproduced: if !p.fromFile { -> if false { inside selectLogtail: reddens Test_selectLogtail_repaintNeverInvokesTheRead and Test_repaintLogtail_noFileAccess as claimed in the fix commit message; reverted, tree clean
